ns2:section.sectionText: Power and Money: Understanding How Wall Street Affects Main Street Consider this a crash course for folks who want to be smarter about how Wall Street and Washington influence what happens everywhere from Hollywood to Haiti. We?ll discuss the good, the bad and the ugly sides of capitalism, including some of the best movies that boast: ?Greed is Good.? We?ll see how the power brokers? decisions trickle down to Main Street and the dwindling Middle Class. Taught by a former Wall Street Journal reporter. No prerequisites or textbooks required.
